en: Yeah... Maybe you're right... As much as it stings...
Yeah, thanks. Just hearing that takes a huge weight off.
Legrance
What kind of country is the Kingdom of Legrance?
My country? Let's see... It's a young country, but I want to help it grow more and more.{wait}{clear}Though I have to stay out of the spotlight... I don't want to cause my brother trouble...
It's blessed with a fine climate, isn't it?
You think so too? Thanks to the climate, the people of Legrance are easygoing and the crops grow well.{wait}{clear}It's one of the things I like to brag about.
Rudi, how do you feel about your country?
I want it to get better, much better than it is now... But...{wait}{clear}Hey, can we drop this for now?
West and East
I heard Legrance used to be two countries...
Huh, you know your stuff. That's right.{wait}{clear}About fifty years ago, the western and eastern kingdoms became one.
The West-East problem...

Yeah... There are lots of problems. My mother had eastern blood, so I'm sure she went through a lot.{wait}{clear}Much more than I'm going through now... much more...{wait}{clear}Mom and my brother protected me, so I grew up carefree as a kid.{wait}{clear}That's why I don't want to cause either of them trouble.
Someday you'll understand each other.
Yeah. I want to believe that, and I want to work to make it happen.{wait}{clear}Hey, let's drop this now. The rest is something I have to handle myself.
Is there something else?
If I get tired, I'll rest when I feel like it. Besides, if you're going to worry about that, don't ask me to do jobs in the first place.
I don't mind. Besides, if you put your feet on the ground and change your point of view, maybe you'll understand this world better.

Yeah... Maybe...{wait}{clear}When you live in a world full of strings attached, walking freely like this can feel like happiness.{wait}{clear}What's with the weird face? You're gonna say that's not like me, right? I know.
I'm not fine, but I have to go, don't I?{wait}{clear}I really do think how nice it'd be if I could pick only easy roads and still get where I'm going.
Do I look that unreliable? Well, I might get lost if I go into a forest or something...{wait}{clear}Then you can go find the way for me. You can fly with those wings, after all.
Heh... Spoken like an angel.{wait}{clear}But I see you think about this world in all sorts of ways...{wait}{clear}I'll give you credit for that.
Yeah... You might think it's not like me, but I think so too.{wait}{clear}Seas and mountains, forests and lakes... There are plenty of beautiful places.
Yeah, they do good work, don't they? Some of them are a bit noisy...{wait}{clear}Well, I'd like you to be choosy about which fairies you send my way.
Little things make me remember all sorts of stuff, but I try not to dwell on it.{wait}{clear}Thinking about it doesn't start anything or change anything...
Yeah, I guess. There are a few people I'd rather not meet, but mostly they're fun folks.
...Spoken like an angel. If I'm going to have these sweet dreams, I'd like you to go home soon.
You came here just to say that? That's so like you...
You ask weird stuff...{wait}{clear}Well, I don't hate sleeping. So could you leave me alone?
Yeah, I'll do that.{wait}{clear}A whole lot has happened since I met ＄＄＄＄＄＄...
I don't do anything special.{wait}{clear}Anyway, why do you care about that? You're a strange one, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Whether I sleep "well," I'm not sure, but I can sleep anywhere.{wait}{clear}I'd rather pass on sleeping outdoors, though.
Not much... I just zone out, I guess? Or else I go out to have some fun.

My home? Who knows... I'd rather not think about it.{wait}{clear}Can I really call the Holy City my home? If I think about it seriously, I don't know.{wait}{clear}But it's the town I was born and raised in. I'd be lying if I said I didn't care.
Yeah... I don't mind... But if I get sleepy, I'm going straight to bed.
Why do you ask such pointless things? Do angels not know anything about humans?{wait}{clear}I'm not in the mood for that kind of talk.
I don't want to do this tedious stuff, but it can't be helped, can it?{wait}{clear}I don't want to die yet.
I don't know what you're getting at, but I don't really want to hear words like that...
Sure, sometimes it's hard.{wait}{clear}But saying so and not doing it won't get me anywhere, right? If I die, it's all for nothing.
Just when I finally feel like doing it, you come and bother me with that?{wait}{clear}Either watch quietly or go home, would you?
Dedicated...? Is that how it looks...? Well, fine. Let's just say that's what it is.
Who knows. You could say I am, you could say I'm not. Well, I've got enough to fight.{wait}{clear}You sure worry about weird things.
Getting hurt? Sure, I'm training, but one look at me and you can see there's no need to worry, right?
Not much, but I do mind people watching, so I don't do this anywhere I'd get interrupted.{wait}{clear}So don't interrupt me either, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
No, same as always. Is something bothering you?
I guess. Without that, there's nothing to keep you going.{wait}{clear}But it doesn't matter that much to me, personally.
If you think so, you could just not come... but you'd still worry, right?{wait}{clear}You really don't have to worry about it.
Yeah, so many it's a pain. Well, you might not understand how someone like me thinks.
Well, I suppose so. Right now there's so much out of the ordinary that doing my usual stuff is the change of pace.
Abrupt as ever.{wait}{clear}But I'd rather not remember much about when I was little... Sorry...
Sure, if that's what you want, go ahead. I don't mind.{wait}{clear}It's nice to relax like this once in a while, right?
Haha... You're stricter than you look.{wait}{clear}Well, I guess you couldn't guard the world otherwise...
Yeah, I'll take you up on that. Why don't you relax a little too, ＄＄＄＄＄＄?
Sometimes... But thinking things through isn't my strong suit.
Of course I go. Rather than moping in a place like this, going out for a drink takes my mind off things.
Yeah... You don't need to worry about that. I'm not a kid.
I know...
Spare me the empty comfort. We've come this far, so calm down, will you?
Yeah... I know...
Hahaha... Harsh... But naturally. I have no intention of letting my guard down.
Don't you think there's no point worrying now? We'll find out when we fight. Whatever happens, happens.
If you're that worried, you didn't have to come all this way...{wait}{clear}Do you trust me that little? Me?
I'm sure you'll be fine, Rocus.
Yeah... I hope so... Though even if you say that, I don't plan to let my guard down.
Don't say ominous stuff like that. What a pain you are...
...Geez, what good is it if YOU can't calm down? If you make that face, it makes me uneasy, right?
No... It's not your fault, ＄＄＄＄＄＄... I just wasn't strong enough.
Don't make such a fuss. I didn't want you to see me looking this pathetic...
Thanks don't mean anything if I couldn't beat the enemy, right?{wait}{clear}And getting wounded like this... It's the worst...
No, there's no point counting on you anyway... Don't worry about it too much.
No... Anyway, don't worry so much. Just being seen like this is humiliating...{wait}{clear}It's just... Ah, no, never mind...
An apology from you only makes it awkward. Besides, this is because I wasn't strong enough, not your fault.
No... I don't mind being relied on... It's just pathetic that I couldn't live up to it...
Say no more... I don't want to hear your excuses.
Harsh, at a time like this... But you may be right...
Yeah...{wait}{clear}Sorry, but I'll do that.
The Church
Rocus, you're going to become Pope, aren't you?
...Apparently...{wait}{clear}Someone like me becoming Pope... What a joke...
The Church gathers everyone's faith, doesn't it?
Crowds of people always visit... That must make you happy, being an angel, right?
That cathedral is truly magnificent...
